common.currentFile: Current file kept unless you choose another

fields.title: Title
fields.keyHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, for example terms. Homepage headings: home-categories, home-live, home-upcoming, home-steps, home-seller (title = heading, text = body).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The sections auctions are listed under, per country.
categories.deleteBody: Categories with auctions can't be deleted; hide them instead.

countries.title: Countries
countries.deleteBody: Countries that have categories, auctions or accounts can't be deleted; hide them instead.

sliders.title: Homepage slides
sliders.description: The banner images at the top of the homepage.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Banner images in the homepage announcements strip.

hero.title: Homepage hero
hero.description: The large welcome section at the top of the homepage: badge, headline, text, buttons and picture. Empty fields keep the built-in text.
hero.empty: The homepage shows the built-in hero. Customise it to change its text and picture.
hero.deleteBody: The homepage goes back to the built-in hero text and the picture of the first live auction.

fields.titleHint: Put words in '{curly braces}' to show them in green and in [square brackets] for purple. Press Enter to start a new line.
fields.ctaUrlHint: A path on this site such as /auctions?status=live, or a full https:// link.
fields.imageHint: Wide photo, at least 1200 × 900 px. Without one, the picture of the first live auction is shown.
fields.altHint: For screen readers. Leave empty if the picture is decorative.
fields.isActive: Shown on the homepage (untick to go back to the built-in hero without losing your text)

about.title: About page
about.description: The text, pictures and numbers on the About page.
about.empty: The About page has no content yet.

benefits.title: Benefits
benefits.description: The benefits listed on the Benefits page.

howTo.title: How-to steps
howTo.description: The steps shown on the How to buy page.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Questions and answers grouped into sections.

faqSections.title: FAQ sections
faqSections.deleteBody: Only empty sections can be deleted.

contactInfo.title: Contact details
contactInfo.description: Phone, email, address and social links shown on the Contact page, per country.

settings.title: Pages & settings
settings.description: Long-form pages such as the terms and the privacy policy.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Messages sent from the Contact page.

translations.title: Translations
translations.description: Change any interface text. Overrides apply to the whole site within a minute; “Reset” returns to the shipped text.
translations.placeholders: Keep any word in curly braces, such as '{'name'}', exactly as it is, or the text will show an error.
